mapper.select: SELECT NVL( (SELECT settlement_id FROM settlement WHERE period = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND company_id = #{value}), 0 ) AS settlement_id FROM dual
mapper.update: update settlement set total_pay=total_pay+#{total_pay} where settlement_id=#{settlement_id}
update settlement set total_pay=total_pay-#{total_pay} where settlement_id=#{settlement_id}
